paired_statistics.interpretation: Paired synthetic outcomes; p-value is descriptive only and does not adjust for within-seed or within-format dependence. At least five independent seed clusters are needed for a seed-level interval. No evidence of real LLM improvement without actual live-model experiments and larger heldout sets.

protocol.candidate_order: window, tie-break, decay Cartesian order; baseline cached
protocol.holdout: one final selected/baseline/fixed-lower/fixed-trim comparison; no tuning afterward
protocol.selection: strict validation gain; aggregate training and every validation scenario nonregression against incumbent and baseline

replay_protection: operator-owned SQLite; not independent holdout custody
scope: Public synthetic strategy-selection fixture; not scientific discovery or model training.
